didYouKnow: 1 in 8 people globally (970 million) live with a mental health disorder.
Depression is a leading cause of disability worldwide, affecting 280 million people.
Over 720,000 people die by suicide every year — suicide is the 3rd leading cause of death in 15–29 year olds.
Countries spend less than 2% of their national healthcare budgets on mental health on average.

faq.q: How many people live with a mental health disorder globally?
faq.a: According to the WHO, approximately 970 million people — or 1 in every 8 people on Earth — live with a diagnosed mental health disorder.

faq.q: What is the most common mental health disorder?
faq.a: Anxiety disorders are the most common, affecting 301 million people globally, closely followed by depressive disorders affecting 280 million people.
